blocks.text: Rachel Chinouriri is pleased to today share her second studio album I think I spoke too soon via Atlas Artists / Parlophone Records. She also shares the Dora Paphides-directed video for ‘Pretty girls’, a euphoric ode to the magic of womanhood that embraces feelings of pure embodiment and freedom. Of the track, Rachel shares: “Pretty girls is the anthem for all women wanting to express who they are with the freedom to not be judged. When I say all women I mean it. Straight women, queer women, trans women, masc women, non binary people and anyone who supports the girls. I […]...
